instant-p2p-server.terms.heading: §b§lFranchise Terms §7(version %s)
instant-p2p-server.terms.body:
§7Franchise Terms of Use & Privacy Notice (revised 2026-09-30)

"Franchise" is an unofficial modified build of Instant P2P (by KITE2459) and a relay server run separately by its operator. It is not affiliated with the original author or the official server (HQ). Do not contact the original author about the Franchise.

1. Service
The Franchise server only helps players find and connect to rooms. Game data flows directly between host and players.

2. Limitation of liability
This mod only helps you join LAN servers. We are not responsible for problems between users. P2P can expose your IP to others; enable 'Force relay' to prevent that. Never give personal info, open links or install programs because someone in a room asks you to.

3. Data collected (only while using the Franchise)
- Device identifiers: network adapter MAC addresses, OS installation ID, system disk volume number (the last two combined with the computer name). Raw values are never sent - only irreversible SHA-256 hashes computed on your computer.
- Connection data: IP address, time, room code, mod version
- Account: Minecraft name and UUID (when verifying a premium account)
- Public room info: title, channel, player count
- Online status: every minute while the game is running with the Franchise selected - whether you are online, the code of the room you joined or opened, and, if you are the host, the names/UUIDs of players in your room
- Reports: names/UUIDs of reporter and reported player, reason, and the reporter's IP address
While using HQ or before you accept these terms, your game does not connect to the Franchise server, so nothing is collected. When relayed connections are used, the relay server also logs connecting IPs.

4. Purpose
Relaying connections, checking service status (who is online and who is in each room), enforcing bans (device/IP/account), preventing spam and abuse, preventing crime, handling reports, and cooperating with lawful requests from law enforcement.

5. Retention
- Connection records (when you opened or joined a room and when you left, room code, IP address, device identifiers, account): automatically deleted after 3 months.
- Online status: kept in server memory only; erased a few minutes after it stops or when the server restarts.
- Player (name, UUID, IP, device identifiers, last seen), report and flagged-room records: automatically deleted at most 1 year after the last entry.
- Ban records: kept until the ban is lifted.
- Records that must be preserved as evidence (law-enforcement requests, reports or disputes): kept separately, regardless of the periods above, until the matter is closed, then deleted.
- Server logs (including connecting IPs logged by the relay server): oldest removed once a size limit is reached.

6. Sharing
We do not sell or share your data, except when legally required by law enforcement.

7. Restrictions
Illegal or crime-related rooms, spam, abuse, adult content, cheats and ban evasion are prohibited. Violations can lead to a 1-hour soft ban up to a permanent ban; offending rooms may be hidden or closed.

8. Under 14
Users under 14 must have a parent or legal guardian's consent before using the Franchise.

9. Your rights
You may request to view or delete your data via the contact published in the operator's notice.

10. Changes
If these terms change you will be asked again. If you do not agree, you can keep using HQ (the official server).
instant-p2p-server.terms.server_note: §e[Server Edition] While using the franchise server, it sends the same information as the franchise mod — the host account (name, UUID), the server IP, the invite code, public room info, device identifiers (hashed) and a presence report every minute (room code, players' names and UUIDs). Nothing of this is sent while using the official server.
